Our cutting-edge mask writers power the world's most advanced chip manufacturing, making high-performance smartphones, PCs, and data centers possible. By pushing the boundaries of nanofabrication, we enable innovation at the smallest scale -- driving progress on a global level.

Job Description

As a Master Data Specialist, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, consistency, and integrity of technical master data across the entire product lifecycle. By connecting Engineering, Procurement, and Operations, you will help maintain reliable product data that enables efficient processes, supports manufacturing excellence, and drives business success.

If you are passionate about structured data, technical processes, and continuous improvement, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

Key Responsibilities:

- Maintain, create, and audit engineering master data within our ERP landscape, including material masters, Engineering Bill of Materials, and Provision BOMs

- Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and quality of technical master data throughout the entire product lifecycle

- Govern product lifecycle processes, from development and release through end-of-life and obsolescence management

- Define, implement, and continuously improve data governance standards and best practices

- Identify and resolve data inconsistencies, process bottlenecks, and cross-functional master data issues

- Support the cleanup and optimization of legacy data structures

- Collaborate closely with R&D, Engineering, Procurement, Service, Product Management, and Operations teams

- Contribute to process improvement initiatives and support the ongoing development of engineering data management processes

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field

- Strong understanding of Bill of Materials (BOM) structures, product data management, and revision control processes

- Hands-on experience with ERP systems and engineering master data management

- Excellent attention to detail and a structured, quality-focused approach to work

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify data inconsistencies and drive process improvements

- Ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders across R&D, Engineering, Procurement, Operations, and other business functions

- Excellent communication skills in English, German preferred

- Experience with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems, Engineering Change Management (ECM) processes, or complex product structures is considered an advantage

- Previous experience in a manufacturing, industrial, high-tech, or engineering-driven environment is a plus

- Interest in data governance, process optimization, and maintaining high-quality engineering data throughout the product lifecycle

Additional Information

What you can look forward to:

- Career & Development: Exciting opportunities to grow professionally and personally - in an international environment

- Team Culture: Dynamic, collegial and open to new ideas - together we are writing the future

- Health & well-being: Company doctor and psychologist - support for your health

- Bonus program: All employees benefit from our success - together we achieve more

- Job bike: Environmentally friendly commuting and staying fit - with us you can lease your bike at a reasonable price

- Events & team building: Summer party, business run, cool team events - we celebrate our successes together

- Employee discounts: From car washes to wellness days - benefit from many discounts

- Catering: Subsidized canteen, fresh fruit and drinks right in the office

- Mobility: Shuttle bus for a comfortable journey, free parking spaces, e-charging stations for cars and motorcycles, bicycle parking spaces with e-bike charging station

With us, you'll receive an attractive gross monthly salary of 2,200.00 EUR (full-time basis, Metal Trades Collective Agreement).
